facts.text: The repository is an MCP server that drives a Rigol MSO/DSO oscilloscope over SCPI/PyVISA
The package declares pyvisa and pyvisa-py as runtime dependencies and no vendor scope SDK
Scope is the high-level control of one connected instrument
establish queries *IDN?, selects the dialect and returns a Scope
PyVisaTransport.open opens a VISA resource and sets newline read and write terminators
Scope.identify returns the parsed identity
Scope.reset writes the dialect reset command and then the clear-status command
Scope.configure_channel writes the display, scale, offset, coupling, bandwidth limit and probe ratio of one channel, then checks :SYSTem:ERRor?
Scope.configure_logic requires at least one digital channel, validates it against the model's count and writes enable and threshold for each channel
Scope.configure_trigger writes the trigger mode and, only in EDGE mode, the source, slope and level
Scope.capture writes RUN, STOP or SINGle and then checks :SYSTem:ERRor?
Scope.measure queries one measurement item, parses a float, rejects the 9.9e37 sentinel and returns the value with a unit
Scope.screenshot returns the native screenshot bytes
The MSO5000 screenshot is always a 24-bit BMP
Scope.read_waveform transfers a byte waveform, converts it with the preamble and downsamples it to max_points
Scope.raw_scpi queries when the command ends in '?' and writes otherwise
The MSO5000 dialect declares 4 analog channels, 16 digital channels and a vertical scale from 5.0e-4 to 10.0 V/div
The API coupling tokens are dc, ac and gnd, with the SCPI spellings DC, AC and GND
The API bandwidth-limit tokens are off and 20m, with the SCPI spellings OFF and 20M
The trigger modes are edge, pulse and pattern, with the SCPI spellings EDGE, PULSe and PATTern
The edge-trigger slopes are rising, falling and either, with the SCPI spellings POSitive, NEGative and RFALl
The measurement items are vpp, vrms, freq, period, duty, rise, fall, delay and phase
The capture actions are run, stop and single
DeviceLimits carries the per-model channel counts and vertical-scale bounds used for pre-validation
The dialect translates CH1 to CHANnel1 for a source token
